headline: 9 Michigan deals, $13.3M raised — led by ENDRA Life Sciences Inc.

top_deals.summary: ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. (NDRA) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement with ASP Isotopes Inc.; filing cites a figure of ~$200M.
Enspire Fund, LP, a Birmingham-based private equity fund, disclosed a $150M raise; $0 sold.
Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. (ULH) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement; filing cites a figure of ~$38M.
Sterile State, Inc., a Grand Rapids-based health care company, filed a $13M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $10.8M sold to 69 investors. (Amended filing.)
Stagecoach Capital Wyndham Lakes LLC, a Rochester-based company, filed a $8M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $0 sold.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $13.3M sold across 6 Form D filings this week, down 87% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Sterile State, Inc. (Grand Rapids, Other Health Care) targeting $13M. Good question to ask: are founders in health care & life sciences favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. (NDRA) disclosed a deal with ASP Isotopes Inc.. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan health care & life sciences assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $0 raised so far — led by Enspire Fund, LP (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
